svg.title: Thirty Days to a Documented Funding Desk
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-controlled-launch-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty Days to a Documented Funding Desk; subtitle: Four weekly milestones establish operating readiness; the canonical first-deal window remains one to four months.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone end days: 7, 14, 21, and 30. The final interval intentionally spans nine days. A day-30 pilot may remain an unfunded rehearsal if transaction, legal, capital, or escrow evidence is incomplete.; caption: Measure readiness through completed evidence, segregated permissions, and reconciled test files. Never compress underwriting or release conditions to satisfy a calendar target.; stages: label: Days 1-7: define the operating mandate; value: Finish jurisdiction scope, fee logic, and capital-source terms.; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose the initial state and transaction type, document commercial-purpose facts, and establish applicable lender and settlement requirements. Build the $75,000 startup allocation and the exact three-scenario scorecard. Record every facility's usable amount, charges, permitted uses, and repayment timing.; label: Days 8-14: implement evidence and permissions; value: Configure intake, independent callbacks, and a principal-separated ledger.; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Create restricted intake storage, a transaction checklist, and QuickBooks accounts separating principal, fees, capital costs, and losses. Assign owner authorization and contractor verification permissions. Test a changed beneficiary alert and document why the simulated wire remains unreleased.; label: Days 15-21: rehearse complete closing files; value: Complete two unfunded rehearsals and one failure exercise.; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Walk two sample files from contract intake through Qualia or SoftPro statement review and payoff reconciliation. Simulate missing buyer cash, a callback mismatch, and a delayed return wire. Verify that exception ownership and escalation timestamps remain visible.; label: Days 22-30: pilot only a qualified transaction; value: Run one bounded pilot or preserve an unfunded readiness file.; numeric value: 30.0; detail: If all four pre-flight checks pass, use a documented exposure cap, independently verified settlement instructions, and daily payoff tracking. Otherwise continue sourcing without disbursement. Compare actual earned fees and costs with the Base-Case model; do not extrapolate one closing into proven annual performance.

circle.title: label: Days 1-7: define the operating mandate; value: Finish jurisdiction scope, fee logic, and capital-source terms.; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose the initial state and transaction type, document commercial-purpose facts, and establish applicable lender and settlement requirements. Build the $75,000 startup allocation and the exact three-scenario scorecard. Record every facility's usable amount, charges, permitted uses, and repayment timing.

text.title: Finish jurisdiction scope, fee logic, and capital-source terms.

circle.title: label: Days 8-14: implement evidence and permissions; value: Configure intake, independent callbacks, and a principal-separated ledger.; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Create restricted intake storage, a transaction checklist, and QuickBooks accounts separating principal, fees, capital costs, and losses. Assign owner authorization and contractor verification permissions. Test a changed beneficiary alert and document why the simulated wire remains unreleased.

text.title: Configure intake, independent callbacks, and a principal-separated ledger.

circle.title: label: Days 15-21: rehearse complete closing files; value: Complete two unfunded rehearsals and one failure exercise.; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Walk two sample files from contract intake through Qualia or SoftPro statement review and payoff reconciliation. Simulate missing buyer cash, a callback mismatch, and a delayed return wire. Verify that exception ownership and escalation timestamps remain visible.

text.title: Complete two unfunded rehearsals and one failure exercise.

circle.title: label: Days 22-30: pilot only a qualified transaction; value: Run one bounded pilot or preserve an unfunded readiness file.; numeric value: 30.0; detail: If all four pre-flight checks pass, use a documented exposure cap, independently verified settlement instructions, and daily payoff tracking. Otherwise continue sourcing without disbursement. Compare actual earned fees and costs with the Base-Case model; do not extrapolate one closing into proven annual performance.
